typography.rules: Use Cormorant Garamond for headings for a prestigious academic feel. Use IBM Plex Sans for tables, UI, and body. Do not use generic fonts like Inter for headings.

colors.rules: Use deep academic navy (#0A192F) for primary actions and sidebar backgrounds. Surfaces are pure white (#FFFFFF). Background is tinted grey (#F8FAFC). Never use pure black or teal green.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist. Use shadow-sm on cards. Avoid heavy or floating shadows.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces. No glassmorphism as this is a high-trust, data-heavy academic portal. CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, dropdowns, or any surface that has content under it.

grids.admin_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 (High Density Grid for data widgets)
grids.student_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 (Bento Layout for self-service forms)

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing (p-8, p-12) for Student forms. Dense and compact spacing (p-4, p-6) for Admin data tables.
layouts.alignment: Left-align dense content and tables. Center-align only if it improves visual hierarchy. Do not global center align.

motion.rules: Minimalist animations. Use micro-interactions for hover states (e.g., background shifts). Smooth entrance transitions for dialogs. DO NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all).

accessibility.rules: Maintain high contrast for text. Ensure focus states are distinct (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary). Use semantic HTML. Ensure all interactive and key elements include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-request-button').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for a high-end academic feel.

3d_libraries.rules: This is a functional administration portal. Focus on 2D data clarity via Recharts rather than 3D immersion.

instructions_to_main_agent: All components and files MUST be written as .js files, NOT .tsx files. Follow vanilla React + JavaScript guidelines.
Build the Google Auth login page using the provided library background image with a dark overlay (bg-slate-900/80) to contrast the login card.
Build two distinct layouts with role-based navigation: Admin Dashboard (data-heavy) and Student Portal (self-service forms).
Admin Dashboard: Include overview stat cards, global request tables, and master data upload forms.
Student Portal: Build 'Submit Course Request' (Add, Drop, Swap) flows and My Requests timeline.
CRITICAL BUSINESS LOGIC: Ensure the 'Student Dashboard' explicitly HIDES all section capacity data. The Admin Dashboard must be the ONLY place capacity data is visible.
Use standard Shadcn UI logic but customize the styling to match the 'Old Money Tech / Academic' minimal aesthetic (flat borders, no heavy shadows).
Use `sonner` for all in-app notifications (accept/reject swaps, errors, success).
Use Recharts for Admin dashboard visualizations (Total students/courses/sections).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not output generic 'AI slop'. Prioritize distinct, premium frontend execution.
Do not apply global text-align center (`.App { text-align: center; }`).
Always use `data-testid` on buttons, inputs, and key UI markers for robust testing.
Never use placeholder image URLs (via.placeholder, dummyimage, etc.). Use the provided image URL.
Ensure layered design elements have proper z-index hierarchy and no transparent background collisions.
